Record Class ExportOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.export.ExportOptions
Record Components:
format - the export media format (GIF or MP4)
width - the canvas width in pixels
height - the canvas height in pixels
fps - the target frames per second
secondsPerRotation - the duration of each complete rotation in seconds
rotations - the number of complete rotations
showName - true to display the molecule name label
showFormula - true to display the chemical formula label
background - optional RGB background color integer, or null for transparency
direction - the rotation direction (forward or reverse)
cubic - true for cubic atom rendering style, false for spherical
columns - the number of columns in a gallery export grid
filename - the validated output filename
encoder - optional path to an external FFmpeg encoder executable
moleculeCount - total number of molecules being exported
textScale - the scale factor applied to text labels
public record ExportOptions(ExportOptions.Format format, int width, int height, int fps, double secondsPerRotation, int rotations, boolean showName, boolean showFormula, Integer background, Config.RotationDirection direction, boolean cubic, int columns, String filename, String encoder, int moleculeCount, double textScale) extends Record
Validated, immutable settings for one export.

Saved appearance settings are only read.

    • yawAtFrame

      public float yawAtFrame(int frame)
      Calculates the rotation yaw angle at a given frame.

      The endpoint is deliberately omitted: the next frame after the last is the first again.

      Parameters:
      frame - the zero-based frame index
      Returns:
      yaw angle in degrees
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the frame index is out of bounds
